name: Shading-Guided NeRF Synthesis
definition: A method to synthesize large-scale NeRF scenes from a smaller exemplar by controlling lighting effects using shading vectors, avoiding the need to decouple geometry, material, and lighting.
summary: Shading-Guided NeRF Synthesis generates large-scale radiance fields from exemplars using shading vectors to ensure continuous lighting, avoiding the discontinuities of feature grid matching.
